title: CurrencyCraft
description: A small NeoForge mod that adds Bills to use as currency on servers!
body:
Ever wanted to have a currency that is easy to use yet fits together inside Minecrafts gameplay? Introducing CurrencyCraft, a mod that allows you to easily get and use currency with vanilla items. 

To get started, you have to craft a Crate using a chest surrounded by copper ingots. You can create up to 4 tiers of crates, with each one able to give a higher tier of currency and more of the lower tiered ones.
